entries.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of concepts, theories and principles in Physics
entries.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of the concepts, theories and principles in Physics
entries.learning_activity: (a) Explain the fundamental principles of measurement (dimensional analysis, precision, accuracy and uncertainties)
teaching_learning_activities: Think-ink-pair-share: Give opportunity to students to perform individual tasks on the fundamental principles of measurements and allow them to share with others
Hands-on activities: Provide students with the opportunity to engage in real-world activities re lated to the fundamental principles of measur ements
entries.assessment: Fundamental principles of measurements are clearly explained
entries.references: TIE, Physics for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Five: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education

entries.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of concepts, theories and principles in Physics
entries.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of the concepts, theories and principles in Physics
entries.learning_activity: (c) Describe the fundamental concepts, principles and theories underlying the thermal properties of materials (heat transfer, kinetic theory of solids, liquids and gases, thermodynamics and thermal radiation)
teaching_learning_activities: Scenario: Guide students to discuss some scenarios related to transfer of heat or radiation in different materials
Virtual simulation: Allow students to explore and manipulate thermal properties of materials virtually
Practical work: Guide students to carry out experiments on thermal properties of materials related to their real-life experiences
entries.assessment: Concepts, principles and theories underlying the thermal propertiesof materials are correctly described
resources: calorimeter and thermocouple thermometers, calorimeter and thermocouple
entries.references: TIE, Physics for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Five: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education
